en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a rural lane flanked by rows of blossoming trees, likely in springtime. A man in traditional early 20th-century attire stands on the left side of the dirt path, holding a rake. The trees are in full bloom, and in the distance, a small building or farmhouse is partially visible. The text in the upper left corner reads: 'Cossebaude. Partie in der Baumblut.'
